subject: ik.graph.v1
question: dead_end_count
node: graph node id (n plus the canonical state digest). A source label alone does not identify the node.
command: A named command is a graph edge, not a stuckness claim. Only outcome committed is a continuation.
refusal: A refused or noop edge is a self-loop. It does not leave the node.
stuck: Non-terminal, not listed in frontier, and no committed outgoing edge.
frontier: A frontier node was not fully expanded. It is not counted as a dead end.
evidence: exhaustive_finite_model only when graph.complete is true and frontier is empty. Otherwise bounded_paths.
finding: Zero dead ends on a closed graph is holds_in_scope for this question only. Zero dead ends on an incomplete graph is inconclusive, not unreachable and not holds_in_scope.
unsupported: Any question other than dead_end_count, and any property_class other than finite_scope_stuck.
